cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: You Can’t Leave Mid-Prophecy
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the impossible prediction has been fulfilled, disproved, or responsibly revised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Keep your coat off. The prophecy says this bell-less tower will ring at noon; I need a witness.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then sign that before you go. We can officially stop waiting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My watch is five minutes fast.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give me four more minutes. I'll fill in our names so only the silence needs witnessing.

mechanism: A controls the witness's departure until the tower prediction can be tested at the corrected time.
confusable: Unlike inventing an arbitrary delay, A uses B's admitted clock error to calculate the necessary remaining wait.
comparison: A four-minute timing correction differs from clarifying an unspecified day with Gran.
seedUse: The seed already withholds departure until signature and corrects the wait, making S01 a concrete release condition.
